ITA-9.6.75 tunnasevanī तुन्नसेवनी
Darning suture
A subcuticular suture.

.51 tūnī तूनी
Bladder pain radiating towards anus and penis
A disorder characterized by pain travelling down from colon and urinary bladder; tearing sensation in genitals; tearing sensation in anus; severe pain in bladder region.
